verdict.rationale: The aihero.dev/skills page enumerates all available skills with one-line descriptions (docs-11 through docs-37), functioning as a browsable catalog, and the skills set was accepted into Claude Code's official marketplace with a documented `claude plugins install` route (docs-10). However there's no evidence of a searchable index, ratings/leaderboard, or in-CLI discovery beyond a flat list. Missing for 10: a searchable/filterable registry UI, in-CLI 'list available skills' command, community ratings or leaderboard signal, and independent confirmation the marketplace listing is browsable rather than just installable by exact name.
